hooks.command: IN=$(cat); sid=$(printf %s "$IN" | jq -r .session_id); d="/tmp/matrx-landing-dirty-$sid"; m="/tmp/matrx-landing-shown-$sid"; f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.matrx/LANDING_CHECKLIST.md"; if [ -f "$d" ] && [ ! -f "$m" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then touch "$m"; jq -n --rawfile cl "$f" '{decision:"block", reason:("Pre-finish gate (fires once per session): scan this landing checklist. If nothing you touched this session appears on it, state that in one line and finish. If something does, verify the paired item before finishing.\n\n"+$cl)}'; fi
